name.ja: メカコレクション 1式空間戦闘攻撃機コスモタイガーII(複座型/単座型)
name.en: Mecha Collection Type 1 space combat attack aircraft Cosmo Tiger II (two-seat type/single-seat type)

description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202 愛の戦士たち』より、１式空間戦闘攻撃機コスモタイガーII（複座型/単座型）がメカコレクションにラインアップ！
description.en: From "Space Battleship Yamato 2202 Warriors of Love", Type 1 space combat attack aircraft Cosmo Tiger II (two-seat type/single-seat type) is added to the mecha collection!

description.ja: • ディテールを優先にパーツを分割し、劇中をイメージしたパース感のあるフォルムを再現。
description.en: • The parts are divided with priority given to details, and the form is recreated with a sense of perspective that is reminiscent of the movie.

description.ja: • 複座型と単座型を選択式で組み立てることができる。
description.en: • A two-seat type and a single-seat type can be selectively assembled.
